title: Understanding Precision
text: Precision is the ratio of true positive predictions to the total number of positive predictions made by the model. Think about how changing the threshold might affect the number of true positives and false positives.

title: Effect of Lowering the Threshold
text: Lowering the threshold means that the model will classify more instances as positive. Consider how this might impact the number of false positives and true positives.

title: Analyzing Precision Change
text: If you lower the threshold, what happens to the number of false positives?

title: Impact on True Positives
text: When the threshold is lowered, what happens to the number of true positives?

title: Precision Formula
text: Remember, precision is calculated as true positives divided by the sum of true positives and false positives. Consider how changes in these values affect precision.
